notes.title: New Engine Version
notes.notes:
[i]Z Arena 1.1 06 110422 : Major Update.[/i]

[h1]What's new ? ːsteamthisː[/h1]
[list]
[b][*]  Moved the game from the old engine version 2018.3 to the new version 2021.2
[*]  Brand new game UI.
[*]  New lighting and higher graphics with the same performance.
[*]  New smoother loading screens.
[*]  Advanced Navigation system.
[*]  Kill streak system.
[*]  Now supports Nvidia game overlay.
[*]  Changes in physics.
[*]  Added ability "for testing only".
[*]  New "Game Over" menu.[/b]
[/list]

[h2]ːblaserː Upgrades ːblaserː[/h2]
[list]
[*]  Smooth HP Bar when player gets hit by enemy.
[*]  Improved "Select map" menu, now has more modes.
[*]  Indicators above enemies when hitting 3 kill streak.
[*]  Improved sounds and added more action SFX to the gameplay.
[*]  New blood splash when hitting an enemy.
[*]  Warning when the player reaches the map's limit.
[/list]

[h2]ːblaserː Ramadan Event ːblaserː[/h2]
[list]
[*]  New map "UNDERGROUND" made for this event.
[*]  New Main Menu style, theme and music.
[*]  Player can collect Sambosa from enemies now
	why ?
	to open the Ramadan Chest for a reward.
        your Sambosa will be saved for the next play.
[*]  Get "Vinto" instead of Med-kit to regain your health.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374910/4de11f92e25728753ab6b061b49f3522ab0b50b8.png[/img]

[h2]ːblaserː Fixes ːblaserː[/h2]
[list]
[*]  General fixes on all maps and menus.
[*]  More LODs to make the game run smoother.
[*]  Player can now view "Highest round".
[*]  Now users with 2 or more display screens are locked to one display screen.
[/list]

[h2]ːblaserː Changes ːblaserː[/h2]
[list]
[*]  Removed map "Cold Edge" temporary for maintenance.
[*]  Removed map "Havoc" temporary for maintenance/ Havoc LMS remains.
[*]  Changes on all weapons and weapons upgrades.
[/list]

Thank you so much for your support!
Totally appreciate you playing the game on early access.

Let me know what you think of this update and what you want to see next!

[url=https://www.itsbasem.com/contact-me]Contact The Developer[/url]

notes.title: 2021 Major Update | Batter Gameplay Experience
notes.notes:
Working hard to provide the best quality and performance.
but here we are back with a better gameplay experience!

[h2][ Major Updates ][/h2]
[list]
[*]  Switching weapons now available! you can switch between primary weapon from the wall and a static secondary gun for your characters. "More coming soon".
[*]  New weapons "TEC-S" secondary "TEC-M" primary.
[*]  A Copy of map "Havoc" without Kate now available
        [olist]
[*] The main gate is disabled.
[*]         Map is in the morning.
[*]         Removed "Kate".
[*]         No extraction mission.
[/olist]
[*]  Added headshot and kill markers.
[*]  Added reverb zones to different areas now will sound more realistic.
[*]  Added a new skin for "M21" : Sharp Edged, available in the armory for 3000 ZC.
[*]  New puzzle "for testing" on map "The Factory"! Shoot the glowing cubes to unlock the golden TEC-M.
[/list]

[h2][ General Changes and Fixes ][/h2]
[list]
[*]  Fixed getting stuck in trees on "Deathrattle".
[*]  New fonts for hit score and head shot score and others.
[*]  Added slide animation and changed texts styles when pointing on items to buy.
[*]  New kill sound effects.
[*]  Increased brightness on "Deathrattle".
[*]  Fixed some issues in Armory.
[*]  Fixed weapons customization panels.
[*]  Fixed many bugs on "Havoc" and getting through walls.
[*]  Now you can skip the second scene when playing "Havoc".
[*]  Changed the way "Ammo texts" are appearing, now its smaller and more clear.
[*]  Replaced pistol floating from the last update.
[*]  New UI when selecting a map.
[*]  Added map difficulty when hovering on the map's image.
[*]  Changed weapon's red dots to move dynamically with the weapon's rotation, you can view that with these weapons : "Master 21", "LC", "TEC-M".
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374910/6445e196c1ac14d754592e32dc7defea8213a429.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374910/56d77f1175bf5c843a4aeaa01cc60d902c9beb6f.png[/img]

[h1][BIG ANNOUNCEMENT][/h1]
[b]Story Mode is now temporary closed for bug fixes that ruined the gameplay, its coming back when all parts are completed.[/b]

[h3]Winter Update Coming Soon Stay Toned[/h3]

Please report any kind of bugs on : itsbasem.com/zarena
I appreciate your support.
